name: Dr. Mortimer, Blight of the Pits
text:
Instant - {t}: Cure a disease an opponent controls. If you do, create a Silver token.
Attack Reaction - {t}, destroy 2 Silver you control: Target Assassin attack gets go again.

name: Humour Plunge
text:
Action - {r}{r}, {t}: Attack. Go again
If this is attacking an infected hero, this gets +1{p}. (A hero is infected if they control a disease.)
Piercing 1

name: Plague Mask
text:
Instant - Destroy this: Disease tokens can't be created under your control this turn.
Blade Break

name: Isolation Vestment
text:
Action - Destroy this: Assassin attack action cards that target an infected hero cost you {r} less to play this turn. Go again (A hero is infected if they control a disease.)
Blade Break

name: Surgical Gloves
text:
Instant - Cure a disease an opponent controls: Target attack they control gets -1{p}. Destroy this at the beginning of the end phase.
Arcane Barrier 1

name: Second Salvos
text:
While this is in your graveyard, at the start of your turn, you may destroy 2 Silver you control. If you do, equip this.
Instant - Destroy this: {u} your hero.
Blade Break

name: Annihilate the Armed
text:
Contract - You are contracted to banish opponents' attack action cards. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token.
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck.

name: Escaped Subject
text: If the defending hero is infected, this gets go again. (A hero is infected if they control a disease.)

name: Eviscerate the Enervated
text:
Contract - You are contracted to banish infected opponents' cards. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token. (A hero is infected if they control a disease.)
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck.

name: Excessive Bloodloss
text:
Contract - You are contracted to banish opponents' red cards. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token.
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck. If it's red, repeat this process once.

name: Plunder the Poor
text:
Contract - You are contracted to banish opponents' cards with cost 1 or less. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token.
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck.

name: Sneaking Rot
text: If you've played or activated an attack reaction this chain link, this gets "When this hits a hero, create a Bloodrot Pox token under their control."

name: Wound Extraction
text: If you've hit with a dagger this combat chain, this gets "When this hits a hero, create a Frailty, Inertia, or Bloodrot Pox token under their control."

name: Act on Intel: Whereabouts
text: Target Assassin attack action card with contract gets +1{p} and "When this hits a hero, they choose a card in their hand. Banish it."

name: Cut to the Chase
text:
Target Assassin attack action card with contract gains +3{p}.
Look at the top card of the defending hero's deck. You may put it on the bottom.

name: Bloodrot Trap
text: When this defends and the attacking hero has played or activated a reaction this chain link, create a Bloodrot Pox token under their control.

name: Frailty Trap
text: When this defends an attack with go again, create a Frailty token under the attacking hero's control.

name: Inertia Trap
text: When this defends an attack with {p} greater than its base, create an Inertia token under the attacking hero's control.

name: Viral Diffusion
text:
Mortimer Specialization
When this defends, create a Frailty, Inertia, and Bloodrot Pox token under the attacking hero's control.

name: Seeker Kunai
text:
Attack Reaction - {r}, destroy this: Target Assassin attack action card gets +1{p}.
While this is in your graveyard, at the start of your turn, you may destroy 2 Silver you control. If you do, return this to the arena.

name: Spreading Plague
text: Create X Bloodrot Pox tokens under the defending hero's control, where X is the number of defending cards this chain link.

name: Codex of Bloodrot
text:
Each hero puts a card from their hand face-down into their arsenal.
Create a Ponder token under your control and a Bloodrot Pox token under each opponent's control.
Go again

name: Pick Your Poison
text:
Each opposing hero chooses Frailty, Inertia, or Bloodrot Pox. Create the 2 tokens they didn't choose under their control.
Go again

name: Annihilate the Armed
text:
Contract - You are contracted to banish opponents' attack action cards. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token.
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck.

name: Languid Pace
text: When this attacks or defends, create an Inertia token under each hero's control.

name: Under the Trap-Door
text:
Stealth
Instant - Discard this: Banish target trap from your graveyard. If you do, you may play it this turn and if it would be put into the graveyard this turn, instead banish it.

name: Viral Sampling
text:
Stealth
Contract - You are contracted to hit an infected opposing hero. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token. (A hero is infected if they control a disease.)

name: Shred
text: Target card defending an Assassin attack gets -2{d} this combat chain.

name: Seed Inertia
text: Create an Inertia token under each hero's control.
